adoption.rationale: Exact-pin caller review traces stored scan-result fields through the shared finding-row renderer into tbody.innerHTML. The contract is limited to text-node output of the source-pinned esc helper; its per-codepoint map and ordered global replacement composition are checked by Z3, an exact-source mutation replay, and a differential product gate.

declared_domain: Exact AutoAR 20-r2 pin 01cd447ad3b1acfed7e0680596c2c74458a4cf06 and source html-escape.js SHA-256 8b3dd2cc810e7e5c0a88095ca04257a0755f0d22d2fa7d05f2e3479c1f70a900. The formal claim is per Unicode codepoint: the output token from the five exact, ordered global substitutions contains none of <, >, double quote, or apostrophe. The helper applies those single-character replacements across the complete input string; the exact-pin product gate compares the composed helper with an independent codepoint map over all valid BMP scalar values plus adversarial and seeded multi-codepoint strings. Input strings have no formal length bound. This is not a theorem about other AutoAR helpers or HTML contexts.
guarantee: For untrusted scan-result text passed through HtmlEscapePage.esc before insertion into an HTML text node, the pinned ordered global substitutions map each Unicode codepoint to itself or a fixed entity token that contains none of the raw HTML delimiters <, >, " or '; therefore their composed output cannot introduce HTML markup through those text-node values. This contract does not cover JavaScript, URL, CSS, or arbitrary attribute contexts.
input_source: String fields from stored scan-result files returned by /api/scans/{id}/results/file, including target- and response-derived values, are flattened into finding rows and rendered through the shared esc helper before tbody.innerHTML receives the row markup.
